en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small industrial town set in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground are factory buildings with tall chimneys and dense town housing. Toward the center stands a prominent church with a tall tower and Baroque-style dome, surrounded by residential blocks and open plots. Farmland and wooded hills lie in the background. In the lower right corner, white printed text reads "Aue i. Erzgeb." indicating the town and region.
